changes: Keep Dashboard traffic and device tiles aligned with the subscription action and preserve connection link dimensions through loading.
Keep the Set Up VPN label when the device limit is full and open device management for that state.
Keep the first active unlimited subscription skeleton aligned with the loaded overview, servers, renewal, devices, and additional options.
Smooth loading transitions for renewal, the classic purchase flow, and the tariff catalogue.
Reveal the Support contact and ticket list without abrupt layout changes, and show the disabled New Ticket action while availability is loading.
Use compact mobile ticket photo previews while retaining the full-screen viewer.

limitations.summary: Classic purchase still requires manual confirmation after balance top-up.
Physical Telegram Mini App and native client coverage is unverified for this release.
External panel app configuration and merchant sandbox checkout/recurring flows were not part of the verified browser scope.
The unused createEmail wrapper is unchanged; current UI uses the supported combined endpoint.
A delayed subscriptions list can temporarily expose a renewal action for an active daily tariff. Reproduced on the previous stable and this candidate.
